schema_audit.ten_million_pipeline_note: Computed directly from raw transactions file via chunked disk-backed aggregation. Distinct customer counts and repeat buyer counts are derived with exact SQL distinct evaluation.
schema_audit.date_proxy_note: Because verified launch dates are absent from the dataset schema, metrics track customer response from the First recorded sale date through the 3-year observation window or 2026-05-31 cutoff.
schema_audit.market_claim_disclaimer: These metrics reflect customer response within this e-commerce dataset only; they do not represent market-wide popularity or market share.
